captions.detailed: A handheld immersion blender consisting of a dark grey cylindrical wand body and a transparent, rounded bottom cup. The wand features a textured central grip band and a top button. The bottom cup houses a blending blade that rotates continuously, while the wand itself attaches to the cup using a press-and-twist joint mechanism.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a handheld immersion blender. Construct a dark grey cylindrical handle with a central grip band, a transparent bottom cup enclosing a blending blade, and define a press-and-twist (revolute and prismatic) joint between the handle and cup, plus a continuous rotational joint for the blade.
captions.factory: Model three main parts: a base cup, a wand body, and a blade. Construct the wand using stacked Cylinder primitives of varying diameters, adding a central grip sleeve and top button. Model the cup with a hollowed-out transparent cylinder or capsule shape, and the blade as a flat box or disc. Define a combined revolute-plus-prismatic joint to connect the wand to the cup, and a continuous rotational joint for the blade.
